name: Apple iPhone 15
shortDescription: iPhone 15 with a 6.1-inch Super Retina XDR display, A16 Bionic chip, 48 MP main camera and USB-C.
description:
The iPhone 15 has a 6.1-inch Super Retina XDR OLED display with the Dynamic Island and runs on the A16 Bionic chip with a 6-core CPU and 5-core GPU.

Its dual-camera system pairs a 48 MP Main camera with a 12 MP Ultra Wide camera, with a 2x optical-quality telephoto option. The front TrueDepth camera is 12 MP. It records 4K video at up to 60 fps, including Dolby Vision HDR.

It has an aluminium design with a Ceramic Shield front and colour-infused glass back, is rated IP68, and supports 5G, Wi-Fi 6, USB-C and MagSafe wireless charging up to 15 W. Apple quotes up to 20 hours of video playback. A USB-C charge cable is in the box; the power adapter is sold separately.
highlights: 6.1-inch Super Retina XDR display with Dynamic Island
48 MP Main + 12 MP Ultra Wide rear cameras, 12 MP front camera
USB-C, MagSafe wireless charging up to 15 W
IP68 splash, water and dust resistance
